source.subject: chemistry
source.authorityName: School examination paper (school not named); obtained from icseboard.org, originally from icseonline.com
source.notes: Typeset school paper with some hand-drawn structural formulae. The PDF text layer uses a non-Unicode font encoding and is unusable, so questions were OCR'd and corrected against page images. Printed session '2017-2018'; examYear taken as the later year. Time printed as '2hrs.+15mins.' (durationMinutes = 120 writing time). Marks come from the printed instruction: Q1 = 20 (a, b, c [4] each, d [8]); Q2-5 carry 2 marks each; Q6-9 carry 3 each; Q10 and Q11 carry 5 each. Where a question has sub-parts sharing one mark allocation, it is kept as one entry. For OR questions, the two alternatives are labelled (a) and (b) in 'part'; the printed sub-part labels stay in the text.
source.usage: School examination paper published on icseboard.org (originally icseonline.com); question text reproduced for study with attribution and a link to where it was obtained. Figures are not reproduced.
